comparisons.reason: Same sources (argument,title), dtype binary, OP own voice. But constructs differ: 35 = OP acknowledges a specific counter-argument, opposing point, exception, or limitation/weakness of own view (includes self-limitation/exceptions). 64 = OP acknowledges that other reasonable perspectives/positions exist (general existence of alternatives; excludes self-weakness admissions). Neither subsumes the other; e.g. 'admittedly this fails for X' is 1 for 35 but not necessarily 64, and 'reasonable people disagree' is 64 but not necessarily a specific counterargument. Edit handling also differs: 35 ignores text marked as edits/post-initial; 64 excludes only clearly marked edits responding to commenters. Not an alignment-only gap.
